features.title: Master of the dead
features.text: Necromancers study occult magic to command the dead. They prepare spells of life and death and raise fragile undead thralls.

features.title: Thralls
features.text: Place thralls to help allies flank, then destroy them to fuel spells. Creatures can pass through them, and they act only through necromancer abilities.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3.5 → 3–4.5. Offensive spells and consuming thralls enable damage-focused builds.
ratings.defense: 2 → 2. Eight HP helps, but caster armor access and positioning limit resilience.
ratings.support: 3–4 → 3.5–4.5. Thralls, occult control and chosen spells create support opportunities.
ratings.utility: 4 → 4. Prepared occult spells and Intelligence provide broad investigative options.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Manage thrall placement, consumption, focus resources and daily spells.
